Dr Rao and his staff are polite, friendly, and respectful.\nUpdate: 28.08.2025\nI am adding this update to bring to the notice of the senior doctor of the practice Dr Rao that something is seriously affecting the efficiency of the reception staff. I am not sure if it is due to staff shortage or staff working to rule.  I made an online repeat prescription request on the 11th of August 2025 but did not hear from the pharmacy to say that the prescription was ready for nearly two weeks. I rang the pharmacy to enquire about my prescription, and they answered promptly and said they haven't received my latest prescription. Therefore, I tried to ring the surgery reception on the afternoon of Friday the 22nd of August but was on put on hold for well over 15 minutes. So I assumed that may the staff have gone home early due to the bank holiday weekend. I tried again on Tuesday 26th of August but was put on hold for a very long time. Then I rang on Thursday, the 28th of August morning, and the call was put on hold with the same repeated message every minute. As I was wasting time on the phone and not making any progress, I decided to go to the surgery in person.  As I approached the surgery front door, I rang the reception to see if it was going to be answered.  The phone wasn't answered although there were two staff at the reception. After about 6 minutes, I approached the reception and enquired if they were short staffed as they weren't answering the phone. The staff who spoke to me said yes, that they are short staffed. I enquired about my repeat prescription and was told yes, it is only ready about two days ago. Please kindly take the necessary actions to avoid keeping the patients on the phone unnecessarily for a long time. By the way, I sent an email on the 26th of August 2025 after not being able to get through on the phone.
